# FDG8013

> DO NOT use weakly typed collections in public APIs.

Framework Design Guidelines, 3rd edition, section 8.3 Collections.

## How it is checked

- Check: judgment
- Automatic fix: no
- Severity: library warning, application none, test none
- Status: verified

Library only: the text scopes it to public APIs. Analyzer candidate rejected: the non-generic interfaces are accepted as inputs by FDG8019 and as extra interfaces by FDG8035, so whether a non-generic type in a signature is weakly typed depends on what the member does with it. CA1010 reports a collection type that implements only the non-generic interfaces (FDG8034), and CA1002, FDG8014 and FDG8015 report the concrete types.

## From the book

The type of all return values and parameters representing collection items should be the exact item type, not any of its base types (this applies only to public members of the collection). For example, a collection storing Components should not have a public `Add` method that takes an `object` or a public indexer returning `IComponent`.

```csharp
// bad design
public class ComponentDesigner {
  public IList Components { get { ... } }
  ...
}
// good design
public class ComponentDesigner {
  public Collection<Component> Components { get { ... } }
  ...
}
```
